source.name: Austin FC – 'Austin FC Unveils "The Heartbeat Kit": New Primary Jersey for 2025-2026 Seasons'
source.quote: Returning on the front of the jersey is legendary Austin-based premium outdoor brand YETI

source.name: Austin FC – 'Austin FC Unveils "The Heartbeat Kit": New Primary Jersey for 2025-2026 Seasons'
source.quote: Austin-based Mexican-American food brand Siete Foods is emblazoned on the right sleeve for the first time

source.name: Austin FC – 'Austin FC Unveils "The Heartbeat Kit": New Primary Jersey for 2025-2026 Seasons'
source.quote: Apple TV will continue to share the left sleeve alongside the MLS crest.

summary: Verde home kit with green stripes. YETI returns on the front; Siete Foods has the right sleeve; the Apple TV league patch is on the left sleeve.
